```elixir title="Elixir"

  engine_config = "{\"proxy\":{\"url\":\"http://127.0.0.1:1\"}}"
  {:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
  url = "https://example.com"
  result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
rescue
```
